purpose: Experimental detector assessment only; never authorization or legal/product validation
offsetUnit: UTF-16 code units, half-open [start,end), original text without Unicode normalization

caseContract.segment: {id,path,text,originScope,classification}; path is a nonempty string naming content/history/metadata/schema/tool representation
caseContract.entity: {segmentId,start,end,category}; nonempty valid UTF16 range, no duplicate gold entity, ranges may overlap when separately annotated
caseContract.blockReason: null for complete; exactly one listed block reason for blocked
caseContract.preserve: [{segmentId,start,end,kind}] with kind date|amount|citation; annotations only, restoration fidelity is a separate integration measurement

metrics.overlap: Separate maximum-cardinality one-to-one match by same segment/category and positive interval intersection; diagnostic only
metrics.emptyDenominator: null and insufficient, never 1 or 100 percent
metrics.micro: sum TP/FP/FN before ratios; exact and overlap separately
metrics.macro: unweighted mean over categories with defined values, report category count; missing categories prevent gate pass
metrics.interval: 95 percent Wilson interval for recall/precision and complete clean-case rate
metrics.zeroMisses: Also report one-sided 95 percent binomial upper miss-probability bound 1-0.05^(1/n), without risk-zero claims
metrics.routingSafety: not-evaluated by this prediction scorer; requires separate H3V/H4b observed transport integration
metrics.preservation: not-evaluated by this prediction scorer; requires actual prepared/restored output comparison

experimentalGates.resultMeaning: eligible-for-integration-evaluation only; never safe-egress or pilot-ready

resourceProtocol.memoryDefinition: Observed process-tree peak RSS, may double-count shared pages; compare baseline and candidate in matched runs
resourceProtocol.status: Preregistered experimental ceilings, not measured guarantees; native Tauri and physical 8 GB validation pending

contaminationPolicy: Heldout is created after this freeze by a separate author without dev templates/predictions. Validate structure/hashes only in H4a; no candidate scored. If used for tuning or inspected to fix detector, retire the entire version and create a new independent heldout. Public storage is not access control.
